last_episode_to_air.name: Behold
last_episode_to_air.overview: Grace and the Greenleaf family must lay the past to rest once and for all as God's plans for the future unfold.

name: Greenleaf
overview: The unscrupulous world of the Greenleaf family and their sprawling Memphis megachurch, where scandalous secrets and lies are as numerous as the faithful. Born of the church, the Greenleaf family love and care for each other, but beneath the surface lies a den of iniquity—greed, adultery, sibling rivalry and conflicting values—that threatens to tear apart the very core of their faith that holds them together.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Although members of the Greenleaf family run a Memphis megachurch, their business and personal lives are tainted with greed, adultery and other sins.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Season 2 picks up with the Greenleaf family tree splitting at the root. Frustrated after her Uncle Mac escapes justice, Grace's righteous pursuit pushes her to the breaking point, with repercussions that reverberate throughout the entire family.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: In the wake of Mavis's revelation, the bishop and first lady's marriage threatens to implode, leaving Calvary's leadership vulnerable to an overthrow.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: The Greenleafs must stand together at a critical moment as a new ministry takes control of Calvary. But buried secrets threaten to shatter alliances.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: The Greenleafs attempt to maintain a united front in the face of loss, but secrets past and present create what could be fatal fractures in the family's fragile foundation. Lady Mae and Grace form an uneasy alliance as they endeavor to reclaim what they've lost.
